CRuby coroutine assembly sources copied verbatim from ruby/ruby at commit c3a285fcf2722ecb0808ad3b24b0f7b6a8b7b95f.

Upstream: https://github.com/ruby/ruby/tree/c3a285fcf2722ecb0808ad3b24b0f7b6a8b7b95f/coroutine
